values.binNote: The stack cap of 3 is not represented as a data value in the sheet; only the resulting bonus damage per rank (CardmasterStack.Damage) and attack speed bonus are given. The '3' is hardcoded in the wiki description text with no corresponding bin row.

values.meaning: empowered attack damage reduced against structures

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of Stacked Deck, stacking up to 3 times; at 3 stacks, the next basic attack is empowered to consume them all and deal bonus magic damage.
mechanics.quote: His basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of ''Stacked Deck'', stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, his next basic attack is empowered to consume them all to deal bonus magic damage

mechanics.claim: Twisted Fate gains maximum stacks of Stacked Deck upon respawning.
mechanics.quote: Twisted Fate gains maximum stacks of Stacked Deck upon respawning.

mechanics.claim: The Stacked Deck on-hit effect can be dodged or missed if Twisted Fate is blinded (and the stack is not consumed in that case), but cannot be blocked (spell shield); a blocked attack still consumes the stacks and applies the bonus damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Stacked Deck'' can be dodged and/or missed if Twisted Fate is blinded (the on-hit effect is not consumed in either case) but cannot be blocked (the enhanced attack is consumed and the bonus damage is still applied)

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack triggers against structures but not wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will trigger against structures but not wards.
